async def act(page):
    # Wait for navigation to the new project page after previous click
    await page.wait_for_url('/projects/new')
    # Wait for the page to load fully
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    
    # Fill in the project name
    await page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Project name').fill('awesome-llms')
    
    # Set visibility to public (assuming a radio button or select option)
    # Look for a radio button with name 'Public' or similar
    await page.get_by_role('radio', name='Public').click()
    
    # Click the 'Create project' button
    await page.get_by_role('button', name='Create project').click()
    
    # Wait for the project page to load (URL pattern for new project)
    await page.wait_for_url('/awesome-llms')
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    
    # Navigate to project settings to add members
    # Click on settings link (usually in sidebar or dropdown)
    await page.get_by_role('link', name='Settings').click()
    await page.wait_for_url('/awesome-llms/edit')
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    
    # Click on 'Members' tab within settings
    await page.get_by_role('link', name='Members').click()
    await page.wait_for_url('/awesome-llms/-/project_members')
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    
    # Add each member: primer, convexegg, abishek
    members = ['primer', 'convexegg', 'abishek']
    for member in members:
        # Fill in the 'Add member' textbox
        await page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Add member').fill(member)
        # Select role (e.g., 'Developer' or default)
        await page.get_by_role('combobox', name='Role').select_option('Developer')
        # Click the 'Add' button
        await page.get_by_role('button', name='Add').click()
        # Wait briefly for the member to be added
        await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)
    
    # Task completed: project created and members added
    print('Project awesome-llms created and members added successfully.')
